class.name: MidiFileReader
class.brief_description: Resource containing raw MIDI file data for playback by GDMidiAudioStreamPlayer.
class.description:
MidiFileReader is a Resource that holds the raw byte data of a MIDI file. It is created by the MIDI importer plugin (import_midi_plugin.gd) when importing .mid files as .midstr resources.
The raw MIDI data is passed to FluidSynth's fluid_player_add_mem() for playback.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Sets the raw MIDI data. Called by the importer during resource import.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the raw MIDI data as a PackedByteArray.

method.name: get_extension
method.description: Returns the file extension for this resource type ("midstr").

members.member: The raw MIDI file data as a byte array.
